name: @alrisali/e2e
description: End-to-end journeys (tester.army e2e) for the web and the iOS simulator.

scripts.build:ios: cd ../../apps/native && CI=1 bunx expo prebuild -p ios && xcodebuild -workspace ios/alrsaly.xcworkspace -scheme alrsaly -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath ios/build ARCHS=arm64 ONLY_ACTIVE_ARCH=YES build
